We're bringing you today's Lunch Break special a little early, thanks to 9to5Toys – AirPods Pro 3 are once again on sale at Amazon, with a discount of nearly 25%, making it one of the best deals of the year.

Last month, Amazon kicked off its Black Friday sales early in July, briefly cutting AirPods Pro 3 by $50, and that deal carried over into August. Now they've slashed the price even further to $189.99 with free shipping.

That works out to a $59 discount off the original $249 price tag – just shy of 25% off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (List Price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (List Price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (List Price $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $149 (List Price $179)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $119 (List Price $179, new) – Renewed Premium refurbished

Brand-new AirPods are likely to arrive as soon as next month, but it will be a long while before we see prices like this. While they are virtually the only upcoming Apple product not affected by the 'RAMpocalypse' for at least the next month or so, the rumored built-in camera design means the price tag is sure to climb significantly higher.

So, if you're willing to spend potentially $300 or more on a pair of 'rearview mirrors' for your ears, you might want to wait.

Today's limited-time offer on AirPods Pro 3 comes amid a broader slate of Apple deals across major retailers, ranging from unlocked iPhone Air deals, MacBook Neo discounts, to $130 off the Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.
